root_cause.text: The freeing of `fmt_src` and `fmt_dst` inside `iris_vdec_inst_deinit`/`iris_venc_inst_deinit` (called during `iris_close`) occurred while the instance was still present in the core list, enabling a concurrent MBPF checker under `core->lock` to dereference freed pointers, causing use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `kfree(inst->fmt_src)` and `kfree(inst->fmt_dst)` from the per-instance deinit functions to after the instance has been removed from the core list (at the end of `iris_close`), as described in the CVE: “iris_close() may free fmt_src and fmt_dst under inst->lock while the instance is still present in the core list. This allows a situation where the MBPF checker, still iterating through the core list, reaches an instance whose fmt_src was already freed… resulting in a use-after-free.”
